# Create Interpolating Polynomial

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Build a one-piece polynomial representation on \[0,2\] with coefficients \[2,3\]. Read back the breakpoints and the full coefficient matrix.
